definition_used: Statement by journal, publisher, company, institution, government agency or author that one or more third party(ies) committed misconduct.
caution: The definition is broad and does not specify the nature of misconduct, so all manuscript categories are potentially implicated. However, without details, the assignment is broad rather than strict.
semantic_rationale: The definition states that a third party committed misconduct, which can affect research content reliability, authorship/attribution integrity, editorial/peer review governance, and post-publication oversight. The process signal is third-party investigation, and the actor context is third party. Problem object is set to article_general as the misconduct could involve any aspect of the article.
